Name: More Doghouses
Author: DellyBelly
Description:
[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]This mod adds new furniture items, rather than replacing vanilla sprites
[*]Visit Marnie to buy a colourful doghouse
[*]Provides 16 variants to choose from
[*]8 roof colours: Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Blue, Purple, Pink
[*]2 vanilla doghouse designs: regular and dark
[/list]
[size=5][b]How to Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿
[*]Download and unzip the mod into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i]
>> alternatively consider using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop [/url]﻿to manage your mods
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list][b][size=5]Configure[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]This mod includes a config.json to adjust the price of the added doghouses if you wish

[*]Default value is 10000, the same as the vanilla doghouses

[*]You can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to select your preferred price

[*]Changes apply on save load
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatability[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+ compatible
[*]Do you want matching pet bowls? Install my other mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22161]More Pet Bowls[/url]﻿

[*]Do you want cheaper pets? Install my other mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21880]Cheaper Pets[/url]﻿
[/list]
[size=5][b]Thank you[/b][/size]
If you've made it this far and you install the mod, thank you. I hope you enjoy it.
And of course a big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] ﻿for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
